title: Top 10 Essential Verbs in Armenian for Absolute Beginners (A0–A1)
dek: Master the 10 core verbs in Armenian (be, have, think, know, like, want, go, can, eat, drink) adapted for A0–A1 learners with collocations and 14-language comparative matrix.

blocks.text: Welcome to our CEFR A0–A1 master guide for high-frequency verbs in Armenian! Frequency studies show that mastering these 10 core verbs unlocks over 80% of everyday communication.

items: **1. To Be (Armenian)** (forms): Core verb for identity and state. *Example:* "Identity and states in Armenian." — *Collocations:* *be ready*, *be happy*, *be here*.
**2. To Have (Armenian)** (forms): Core verb for possession. *Example:* "Possession in Armenian." — *Collocations:* *have time*, *have a book*, *have to*.
**3. To Think (Armenian)** (forms): Mental reflection and opinion. *Example:* "Opinions in Armenian." — *Collocations:* *think that*, *think about*, *I think*.
**4. To Know (Armenian)** (forms): Facts and familiarity. *Example:* "Knowing facts in Armenian." — *Collocations:* *know answer*, *know someone*, *I know*.
**5. To Like (Armenian)** (forms): Tastes and preferences. *Example:* "Preferences in Armenian." — *Collocations:* *like tea*, *like music*, *like doing*.
**6. To Want / Would Like (Armenian)** (forms): Desire and polite request. *Example:* "Desires and requests in Armenian." — *Collocations:* *want water*, *would like tea*, *want to go*.
**7. To Go / Be Going To (Armenian)** (forms): Movement and intention. *Example:* "Movement in Armenian." — *Collocations:* *go home*, *go to work*, *going to*.
**8. To Can (Ability) (Armenian)** (forms): Ability and permission. *Example:* "Ability in Armenian." — *Collocations:* *can speak*, *can help*, *can do*.
**9. To Eat (Armenian)** (forms): Consuming food. *Example:* "Eating food in Armenian." — *Collocations:* *eat apple*, *eat dinner*, *eat food*.
**10. To Drink (Armenian)** (forms): Consuming liquids. *Example:* "Drinking in Armenian." — *Collocations:* *drink water*, *drink tea*, *drink coffee*.
